purpose: Teach: 船橋/府中/松村/岡部/江田/栗原/角田/板橋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、千葉県船橋の支店を強化しろ
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Opens with minimal breath. Each task lands like a directive. Professional distance, no softness. The voice of someone used to compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。東京府中の研究所と連携します
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate with the Fuchu research facility.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Brief pause after the affirmative. Precise, no embellishment. Takes the assignment as stated. Efficient, competent tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の松村部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our new division head, Matsumura.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'welcome'—this is a directive with a human element. Clear and measured. The tone of someone delegating a small kindness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の岡部課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the travel schedule for Okabe, our sales manager.
lines.style: Slightly more detail than before, matching the task. No hesitation. Confirms understanding through specificity. Reliable, methodical pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の江田主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Entrust the project to Eda, our technical lead.
lines.style: Same authoritative clip as the first. Confidence in the assignment itself—this is the right call. Minimal preamble, maximum clarity. Settled tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の栗原様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adopt the strategy Kurihara from PR has proposed.
lines.style: Takes the direction and translates it into action. Small breath before the detail. Confirms the chain of responsibility. Steady, capable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の角田様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Assign the new hire orientation to Tsunoda from HR.
lines.style: Same authoritative rhythm as directive lines. This is the final assignment. Lands with finality. No room for clarification—the structure is set.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の板橋様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request Itahashi from Legal to review the contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Closes the sequence with the same precision it began. Slight settling at the end—the list is complete. Professional, complete.
